sind.definition: n. a region of southeastern Pakistan
sind.translation: n. 信德（巴基斯坦的一个省名）

sindh.translation: n. 信德省（巴基斯坦的一个省）

sindhi.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Sind
n. the Indic language of Sind which is spoken also in western India

sindi.translation: [地名] [爱沙尼亚、印度、乍得] 辛迪

sindolor.translation: n. 欣得乐止痛仪(一种用电流消除钻牙引起的疼痛的仪器)

sindon.definition:
n. A wrapper.
n. A small rag or pledget introduced into the hole in the
   cranium made by a trephine.
sindon.translation: n. <古>(尤指用以做尸衣的)优质布料

sindonology.translation: n. 都灵尸衣学(一门研究据说曾包裹过耶稣遗体的尸布的学问)
